result: FINDINGS: one reproduced keg root-mode gap; pre-install acceptance withheld

findings.title: Validate the keg root mode before excluding it from the member set
findings.evidence: The bound archive root pkgconf/3.0.8 has mode 0o755. validate_keg builds the expected members then removes the root with expected.pop("."). The imported prefix_inventory checks that the root is canonical but emits only descendants. A new scratch AST call changed only the synthetic keg root to 0o777; validate_keg accepted it.
findings.impact: The installation can be reported qualified even though one archive directory has a different, more permissive mode. No later root-mode assertion closes the gap.
findings.requested_change: Assert that the keg root is a real directory and its mode matches the bound root member before removing that member. Keep all existing child, receipt, prefix and protected-state checks.

executed_reproduction.inventory_scope: Explicit synthetic descendant rows mirror prefix_inventory root exclusion; no recursive fixture scan or shared prefix inventory.
